mostWorthwhile.text: Following recovered iron into the marrow was most worthwhile: it connected worn-out cells to their replacements in a concrete way.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the marrow to the body felt mostly like assembly after the replacement process had already been shown.

surprise.text: I was surprised that some cells in the marrow remain while others develop into replacement red cells.

arbitrary.text: Connecting the two renewal routes separately felt somewhat repetitive, though the goal made their purpose clear.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing everyday processes like shedding skin and recycling iron come together was interesting, even if the final fittings were predictable.
